turns.name: purpose
turns.transcript: Okay, and what are you calling about? There's a suspicious payment on your card.

turns.name: open
turns.transcript: Right. Can you explain what's happened in your own words? Um, about 20 minutes ago a £499 payment went to an electronic site. And that's unusual for your account so we put a hold on it. To reverse I need to confirm the long number on the front of your card and then we'll text you a code.

turns.name: followup
turns.transcript: Okay. Is there anything Kevin needs to do? Uh, just to... Just to confound the long number on the front of his card and then just to tell us the code that he gets sent.

turns.name: callback
turns.transcript: Okay, what number can Kevin call you back on? Um, just ring the number on the back of my card.
